constraints_details.constraints_layer_description: CONARA Conservation Area: THE LAKES ESTATE
CILRES CIL ZONE: Higher Rate - RATE: £120 per square metre
DMDCA Designation: Conservation Area- Name: THE LAKES ESTATE- Policy: DMD 37-44- Core Strategy: Core policy 30-31

decision_conditions: The proposed roof terrace by reason of its siting, size and relationship with neighbouring properties, would be at an elevated vantage point offering direct unobstructed panoramic views towards the adjoining rear gardens and back towards the rear elevation on the first floors of adjoining properties. This would cause an unacceptable level of actual and perceived overlooking and undue loss of privacy to habitable room windows and amenity space as well as an unacceptable increased level of noise and disturbance for the neighbouring properties. As such, it constitutes an unneighbourly form of development and the proposal is contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (NPPF, 2021), Policy D4 of the London Plan (2021), DMD 8, DMD9 and DMD68 of the Development Management Document (2014) and Policy CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010).
description: Proposed rear terrace, balustrades and changes to rear facade.
